import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from tools.qualify_cuda_wheels import audit

evidence = {"required_gpus": 1, "audits": {}, "errors": [], "selected_devices": []}
audit(Path(sys.executable), "clean", None, evidence)
audit(Path(sys.executable), "hostile", "/usr/local/cuda/lib64", evidence)
Path(".tmp/spark-qualification/merge-dev-native.json").write_text(json.dumps(evidence, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
print(json.dumps({"errors": evidence["errors"], "audits": {name: {"returncode": item["returncode"], "report": item["report"]} for name, item in evidence["audits"].items()}}, indent=2))
sys.exit(1 if evidence["errors"] else 0)

import importlib.util
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
from unittest.mock import patch

path = Path("native/metal/python/phydrax_metal/plugin.py")
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("spark_metal_namespace_probe", path)
module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
with patch.object(module.metadata, "distribution", return_value=SimpleNamespace(name="phydrax-metal")), patch.object(module.metadata, "entry_points", return_value=()):
    module._refuse_competing_plugins()
    print("installed CUDA namespace accepted by Metal competitor inspection")
    with patch.object(module, "import_module", side_effect=ImportError("namespace absent")):
        module._refuse_competing_plugins()
    print("absent optional namespace accepted")
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as scratch:
        Path(scratch, "metal.py").write_text("")
        with patch.object(module, "import_module", return_value=SimpleNamespace(__path__=[scratch])):
            try:
                module._refuse_competing_plugins()
            except module.PluginError as error:
                print("competing namespace refused:", error)
            else:
                raise RuntimeError("competing namespace was accepted")

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import numpy as np


OUTPUT = Path(".tmp/spark-qualification/benchmarks")


def execute(label: str, module: str, arguments: list[str]) -> dict[str, object]:
    command = [sys.executable, "-m", module, *arguments, "--output", str(OUTPUT / f"{label}.json")]
    started = time.monotonic()
    result = subprocess.run(command, text=True, capture_output=True, check=False)
    (OUTPUT / f"{label}.stdout").write_text(result.stdout)
    (OUTPUT / f"{label}.stderr").write_text(result.stderr)
    record = {"command": command, "returncode": result.returncode, "seconds": time.monotonic() - started}
    (OUTPUT / f"{label}.command.json").write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    print(label, record, flush=True)
    if result.returncode:
        print(result.stdout, result.stderr, flush=True)
        raise RuntimeError(f"Benchmark {label} failed")
    return record


def mace_agreement(report: dict[str, Any]) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
    rows = report["coupling"]
    references = {json.dumps(row["case"], sort_keys=True): row for row in rows if row["route"] == "dense"}
    comparisons: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    for row in rows:
        if "transforms" not in row:
            raise RuntimeError(f"MACE route preparation failed: {row}")
        reference = references[json.dumps(row["case"], sort_keys=True)]
        if row["execution_content"]["sha256"] != reference["execution_content"]["sha256"]:
            raise RuntimeError("MACE comparison inputs differ")
        tolerance = 2e-4 if row["case"]["precision"] == "float32" else 1e-10
        for transform, actual in row["transforms"].items():
            wanted = reference["transforms"][transform]
            if actual["status"] != "measured" or wanted["status"] != "measured":
                raise RuntimeError(f"MACE transform failed: {actual}; reference: {wanted}")
            if row["route"] == "dense":
                continue
            errors: list[float] = []
            for value, expected in zip(actual["output_values"], wanted["output_values"], strict=True):
                if value["shape"] != expected["shape"] or value["dtype"] != expected["dtype"]:
                    raise RuntimeError("MACE comparison output contracts differ")
                x = np.asarray(value["values"], dtype=np.dtype(value["dtype"]))
                y = np.asarray(expected["values"], dtype=np.dtype(expected["dtype"]))
                np.testing.assert_allclose(x, y, rtol=tolerance, atol=tolerance)
                errors.append(float(np.max(np.abs(x - y), initial=0.0)))
            comparisons.append({"case": row["case"], "route": row["route"], "transform": transform,
                                "maximum_absolute_error": max(errors), "rtol": tolerance, "atol": tolerance})
    return comparisons


def main() -> None:
    OUTPUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    commands: dict[str, object] = {}
    for backend in ("jax", "pallas"):
        for precision in ("float32", "float64"):
            label = f"fmm-{backend}-{precision}"
            commands[label] = execute(label, "tools.particle_fmm_benchmarks", [
                "--backend", backend, "--points", "16", "32", "--orders", "1",
                "--distributions", "uniform", "--dtype", precision, "--warmup", "1", "--repeats", "3",
            ])
            report = json.loads((OUTPUT / f"{label}.json").read_text())
            if not report["passed"]:
                raise RuntimeError(f"FMM numerical gates failed: {label}")
    commands["mace"] = execute("mace", "benchmarks.mace_execution_scaling", [
        "--target", "cuda", "--nodes", "8", "16", "--degrees", "2", "--skews", "0",
        "--channels", "2", "--hidden-degrees", "1", "--edge-degrees", "1",
        "--precisions", "float32", "float64", "--receiver-tiles", "2", "--edge-tiles", "4",
        "--routes", "accelerated", "streamed", "dense", "--transforms", "forward",
        "energy_forces", "strain_derivative", "force_loss_gradient", "hvp",
        "--host-initialization", "--repeats", "3", "--label", "spark-gb10",
    ])
    comparisons = mace_agreement(json.loads((OUTPUT / "mace.json").read_text()))
    result = {"successful": True, "commands": commands, "mace_agreement": comparisons,
              "environment": {key: os.environ.get(key) for key in (
                  "JAX_PLATFORMS", "JAX_ENABLE_X64", "XLA_PYTHON_CLIENT_PREALLOCATE",
                  "CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES", "OMP_NUM_THREADS", "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS")}}
    (OUTPUT / "campaign.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    print("All FMM and MACE numerical benchmark gates passed", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from __future__ import annotations

import importlib.metadata
import json
import platform
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import phydrax
import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import numpy as np

from phydrax.backends import cuda_environment
from tools.distributed_substrate_benchmark import run


def main() -> None:
    report = cuda_environment()
    devices = jax.devices("gpu")
    if not report.successful or len(devices) != 1:
        raise RuntimeError(f"CUDA qualification refused: {report.issues!r}; {devices!r}")
    numerical: dict[str, object] = {}
    for dtype in (np.float32, np.float64):
        host = np.linspace(-0.5, 0.5, 33, dtype=dtype)
        values = jax.device_put(host, devices[0])
        function = jax.jit(jax.value_and_grad(lambda x: jnp.sum(jnp.sin(x) ** 2)))
        value, gradient = jax.block_until_ready(function(values))
        expected = np.sum(np.sin(host) ** 2)
        expected_gradient = 2 * np.sin(host) * np.cos(host)
        tolerance = 2e-6 if dtype is np.float32 else 1e-12
        np.testing.assert_allclose(value, expected, rtol=tolerance, atol=tolerance)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(gradient, expected_gradient, rtol=tolerance, atol=tolerance)
        if gradient.devices() != {devices[0]} or gradient.dtype != np.dtype(dtype):
            raise RuntimeError("Smoke output changed device or declared precision")
        numerical[np.dtype(dtype).name] = {
            "value_error": float(np.abs(np.asarray(value) - expected)),
            "gradient_maximum_error": float(np.max(np.abs(np.asarray(gradient) - expected_gradient))),
            "device": str(devices[0]),
        }
    substrate = run(17, 1)
    if substrate["runtime"]["platforms"] != ["gpu"]:
        raise RuntimeError("Execution substrate did not select the CUDA device")
    if not substrate["distributed_pcg"]["converged"]:
        raise RuntimeError("PCG failed to converge")
    if substrate["distributed_pcg"]["maximum_solution_error"] > 1e-12:
        raise RuntimeError("PCG numerical agreement failed")
    if substrate["weighted_mean"]["absolute_error"] > 1e-12:
        raise RuntimeError("Weighted mean numerical agreement failed")
    result = {
        "successful": True,
        "python": sys.version,
        "machine": platform.machine(),
        "phydrax_path": phydrax.__file__,
        "packages": dict(sorted((distribution.metadata["Name"], distribution.version)
                                for distribution in importlib.metadata.distributions())),
        "device": devices[0].device_kind,
        "compute_capability": str(devices[0].compute_capability),
        "cuda_driver_version": report.facts.driver_version,
        "cuda_runtime_version": report.facts.runtime_version,
        "cuda_issues": [{"code": issue.code, "severity": issue.severity, "message": issue.message}
                        for issue in report.issues],
        "numerical": numerical,
        "substrate": substrate,
    }
    output = Path(".tmp/spark-qualification/runtime.json")
    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps(result, indent=2, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
